profile.name: Ahmad Genius
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer & Founder
profile.tagline: Building scalable SaaS products from scratch
profile.bio: Solo architect building a multi-tenant school management SaaS platform serving 500+ schools. Full stack engineer working across web, mobile, and desktop — from MongoDB schemas to React Native crash fixes to Electron desktop tools.

flagshipProject.name: Ai Schooling System
flagshipProject.description: Multi-tenant school management SaaS platform serving 500+ schools, covering fee management, biometric attendance, real-time chat, transport, exams, timetable, payroll, and notifications.
modules: Fee & Finance Management (expenses, income, fines, salary, loans)
Biometric Attendance (AIface device integration over LAN)
Tasks Module (Super Admin → Admin → Staff role hierarchy)
Custom WhatsApp Sender (Baileys-based, no WhatsApp Business API fees)
Custom SMS Gateway (Android device + Socket.IO bridge)
Automated Daily DB Backups (GitHub Actions → Backblaze B2, AES-256-CBC)

otherProjects.name: WhatsApp Sender System
otherProjects.description: MERN backend + Electron desktop app + Socket.IO bridge letting schools send WhatsApp messages via their own paired devices using Baileys — no WhatsApp Business API fees. Event-driven dispatch (zero polling), two-token device auth, in-memory cached history service with debounced disk writes.

otherProjects.name: Biometric Attendance Desktop App
otherProjects.description: Electron app for bulk student uploads to AIface biometric devices over LAN, with image prefetching via keep-alive agents.

otherProjects.name: Console Backend (WhatsApp OTP Service)
otherProjects.description: Baileys-based WhatsApp OTP delivery service built and debugged with key architectural fixes for reliability.

highlights: Built and scaled a multi-tenant SaaS serving 500+ schools solo
Migrated chat system from embedded arrays to a separate Message collection with cursor-based pagination
Migrated AG Grid from MUI DataGrid with full sticky header, 3-section pinning, and context menus
Resolved a persistent Android network hang bug rooted in OkHttp connection pool reuse
Implemented AES-256-CBC encrypted automated backups to Backblaze B2 via GitHub Actions
Built a custom WhatsApp sending system to avoid WhatsApp Business API costs
Integrated Sentry across backend, frontend, and mobile with parallel Crashlytics tracking

experience.description: Solo architect of a multi-tenant school management SaaS across Next.js web, React Native mobile, Electron desktop, Node.js/Express backend, and MongoDB Atlas.
